access: Runs a second local model session with file/command tools inside the active workspace.
description: Note 9: hands work to a second AI that runs and stress-tests it in the workspace before the result is shipped.
name: Tester Seat

tools.description: Delegate verification to the tester AI: give it a concrete test task; it runs tests in the workspace and returns a PASS/FAIL report with evidence. Use after building, before reporting done.
tools.name: run_tester

model.description: Ignored. The tester model is chosen in Agent settings only — the driver does not pick who tests it (governing-seat rule).

task.description: Exactly what to run and verify, e.g. 'Run python3 -m unittest in tests/ and report any failure verbatim'
